subject: Business Models
title: Patent Licensing
description: A fast breakdown of Patent Licensing for builders.

hook.text: Qualcomm earns more from licensing its wireless patents than from selling its own chips.

buildup.text: Every smartphone using 3G, 4G, or 5G pays Qualcomm a royalty—typically 3-5% of the phone's price.

discovery.text: With 140,000+ patents, Qualcomm collects billions annually from competitors who must use its technology.

twist.text: Apple sued Qualcomm for $1 billion, calling the fees excessive. They settled, and Apple still pays.

climax.text: Patent licensing turns R&D into a perpetual revenue stream, even if you never make the product yourself.

punchline.text: Invent the standard, then tax every product that uses it.

quiz.question: How does Qualcomm earn most of its revenue?
